Start Slow: Your First 30 Days Using the PDRN Brightening Serum

How to use the PDRN Brightening Serum in your first 30 days. Start once a day, build to twice a day, what to expect in weeks one and two, and how to compare your skin on day 30 with a photo from day 1.
Start Slow: Your First 30 Days Using the PDRN Brightening Serum
Start slowly with a new serum. If you change everything at once in the first week, your skin may react and you may stop using the serum before it has time to work.
Here is how the first 30 days on the PDRN Brightening Serum are structured, and why.
Week 1: Introduce

Start once a day, in the evening, on clean and dry skin. This lets your skin get used to the ingredients, which are PDRN, a peptide, hyaluronic acid, and panthenol, without changing everything at once. Most people notice the added moisture first. Their skin feels comfortable instead of tight.
Week 2: Build

Move to using the serum twice a day, in the morning and at night, with 2 to 4 pumps each time. This is how the serum is designed to be used, and the Tava plan records it for you. Apply it in the morning before moisturizer and sunscreen, and in the evening before your night cream.
Weeks 3 and 4: Use it the same way every day

By now the routine should feel automatic. It takes two minutes, twice a day, and you do not need to think about it. People who use the serum regularly at this stage typically describe their skin as looking more even in tone and brighter. These changes build gradually with regular use. They do not happen overnight, and sleep, water, and sunscreen also affect how skin looks.
What to expect, stated plainly
Days 1–7:
hydration and comfort. Skin feels softer, looks less dull after cleansing.
Days 8–21:
texture feels smoother, and your face looks more rested in the morning.
Day 30:
compare your photo from day 1 with how your skin looks now. Brightness and even tone change gradually, and photos show changes that you may not notice when you look in the mirror every day.

Start once a day, then build to twice a day. The plan in the app follows the same schedule with you, day by day. The PDRN Brightening Serum is 1 fl oz, which is 30 ml. It costs $49 for one bottle or $39 a month on subscription.
